summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 26th Annual General Meeting held on 6 May 2026. All 25 resolutions were passed by poll, including adoption of annual accounts, re-election of directors, auditor appointments, and authorities to allot shares. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. This is a routine AGM results filing with no forced or abrupt management changes; director elections were standard. No deal terms or premiums are present.
